name: Connected Minimal-Non-Ample Classes Are Not Conditioning-Closed
statement: Every nonempty one-coordinate conditioning is maximum of VC dimension $k-1$, and every nonempty proper iterated conditioning belongs to UOMFib. Hence conditioning always leaves the connected minimal-non-ample class.
proof: The structure theorem gives the exact maximum one-coordinate sections. The UOM classification identifies every iterated conditioning with a topal fiber of the same uniform oriented matroid. In particular, conditioning the six-cycle in any coordinate yields the maximum three-vertex path.
